programmes.d: The annual burning of the sugar cane fields gives players like linebacker Kerry Mullins a chance to partake in a time-honored tradition.
An eligibility issue leads to a serious setback in Glades Central's playoff hopes and leads to rumors that the Pahokee coaching staff is to blame.
A single playoff berth is on the line, and an NFL star returns to fire up both teams. But a tragic act casts a dark cloud over the Muck.
The Muck Bowl once again lives up to the hype.
In Muck City, Fla., head coach DJ Boldin tries to return Pahokee High's football program to its former glory.

With the help of the Student Aces tutoring program, players from both schools achieve success in the classroom; a Pahokee assistant coach faces backlash from the fan base after the embarrassing season opener.
Coach Boldin confronts his coaching staff after sensitive information leaks to the fan base; a crew of Pahokee players uses a bye week to scout their rivals.
A beloved teacher struggles with cancer; one player's unsung academic talent is put on display; a shy student comes out of his shell for homecoming.

BAC Mono, a lightweight, high-speed performance vehicle has the driver's seat positioned at the center of all the wheels; the Brekr Bike, a compact electric moped with an advanced digital display, location tracking, and an advanced suspension system.

The Mambo, the first 3D-printed boat that uses fiberglass for strength; the Ako Trik, an aerodynamically designed, pod-like vehicle with three wheels; the Biomega EV, built for tight urban spaces, has a battery that can be replaced on the go.

Zero Labs' reinvented Bronco is evolved, electric and efficient; the hybrid Frikar Podbike, with two motors in the back wheels, rides like a bicycle with power; the expertly designed Ark Tent is a shelter capable of air suspension.

The aeronautically-designed XP Zero electric superbike; the F1 Simulator combines a high-tech platform with a Formula 1 car's outer shell; the Z Triton, a trilateral, amphibious E-Camper that morphs from trike to electric boat.

The Ramsmobile off-roader has ultimate power behind the wheel; the ED Electric Motorcycle Concept Z uses the latest in EV techniques; the Stator electric scooter has tires that replicate the perfect, stabilizing gyroscopic effect.

The Canoo, an electric modern car; the Sherp N 1120, an extreme all-terrain vehicle that can plow through every obstacle; the Urbet Ego, a twist on the E-Scooter that matches the body and sound of a motorcycle with clean electric power.

Behind the scenes of the Vision Automobile Lab's first biomethane hyper car; the Inmotion V11, an electric unicycle for extreme riding climates; the industrial strength Superstrata, a bicycle tailored to each individual's riding style.
